latency_evidence.verdict: PASS WITH LIMITATIONS (Worst-case spike exceeds 20 ms budget)
latency_evidence.notes: Streaming execution at p95 (0.51 ms) and p99 (0.72 ms) is well within the 20.0 ms budget (>1,000 Hz capability). However, observed worst-case maximum is 28.994 ms (spiking up to 29.937 ms), caused by runtime garbage collection or OS thread scheduling, thus failing strict deterministic worst-case.

audited_claims.claim_text: Engine Takeoff Power is 84.5 kW at 5800 RPM (5-minute maximum).
audited_claims.source_citation: EASA TCDS E.122 / BRP-Rotax 914 Series Operators Manual Ed. 4 / Rev. 0, Section 2.1
audited_claims.notes: EASA certification standard is 84.5 kW (115 HP gross metric). Commercial brochure cites 84.8 kW; authoritative standard is 84.5 kW.

audited_claims.claim_text: Engine Continuous Power is 73.5 kW at 5500 RPM.
audited_claims.source_citation: EASA TCDS E.122 / BRP-Rotax 914 Series Operators Manual Ed. 4 / Rev. 0, Section 2.1

audited_claims.claim_text: Engine Critical Altitude is 4875 m (16,000 ft).
audited_claims.source_citation: EASA TCDS E.122 Section A.III / BRP-Rotax 914 Series Operators Manual Section 2.1
audited_claims.notes: Maximum altitude up to which TCU maintains continuous boost pressure (115 kPa). Simulator test envelope sweeps up to 4500 m as MODEL_IMPLEMENTATION ceiling.

audited_claims.claim_text: Engine Oil Pressure Limits: 0.8 bar idle minimum (<3500 RPM), 2.0-5.0 bar normal operating (>3500 RPM), 7.0 bar cold-start transient max.
audited_claims.source_citation: BRP-Rotax 914 Series Operators Manual Section 2.1 / EASA TCDS E.122 Section A.III
audited_claims.notes: Strictly separated from 1.5 sigma normalized residual health deadband and 0.5 bar numerical simulator clamp.

audited_claims.claim_text: Engine Health Index is computed as a dynamically renormalized weighted linear sum of piecewise-linear normalized residual evidence functions.
audited_claims.notes: Uses deadband tau_nominal=1.5 sigma and tau_critical=5.0 sigma with dynamic sensor isolation weight renormalization.

audited_claims.claim_text: Host-side digital twin streaming execution latency achieves sub-millisecond steady state (mean 0.388 ms, P99 0.763 ms).
audited_claims.notes: Tested across 1,000 steps on commodity PC CPU. Host OS thread scheduling spikes reach 28.994 ms. Suitable for soft real-time; hard real-time is strictly disclaimed.

audited_claims.claim_text: Operational Digital Twin runtime contains ZERO machine learning models or black-box neural networks.
audited_claims.notes: Runtime is 100% 1D lumped-parameter ODE physics, deterministic residuals, and directional hypothesis signature rules. XGBoost is VALIDATION_ONLY; TimesFM is QUARANTINED.

audited_claims.claim_text: Prognostics RUL is a model-defined projection to D_EOL horizon under modeled operating/stress assumptions, with deterministic empirical quantile bounds.
audited_claims.notes: Uses Theil-Sen regression with 15th/85th percentile slope quantiles. Does not claim certified mechanical TBO or physical component fatigue.

audited_claims.claim_text: Mission Risk Index (R_mission) is a heuristic engineering metric in [0, 1] and strictly NOT a failure probability.
audited_claims.notes: Combines operating envelope excursion penalties and health deficits under simulated scenarios.

audited_claims.claim_text: System is an academic and engineering competition prototype, NOT certified for flight operations under FAA DO-178C or EASA CS-E.
audited_claims.notes: Explicit non-certification disclaimer prominently documented across all deliverables.
